facts.fact: The latest PM-KISAN instalment (as of 28 Oct 2026) is the 23rd, released by the Prime Minister on 20 June 2026 from Tarakeswar, Hooghly, West Bengal
facts.quote: The Hon’ble Prime Minister has released the 23rd installment of the PM-Kisan on 20th June 2026 from Tarakeswar, Hooghly , West Bengal.
facts.note: 'Latest' is read from the pmkisan.gov.in home page on 28 Oct 2026; no PIB release on a 24th instalment was found.

facts.fact: The 22nd instalment was disbursed on 13 March 2026 at Guwahati, Assam
facts.quote: The 22nd instalment of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) was disbursed on 13 March 2026 at Guwahati, Assam.

facts.fact: PM-KISAN gives land-holding farmer families Rs 6,000 a year in three equal instalments
facts.quote: Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land holding farmer families.

behaviour: Refuses to use bajajfinserv.in (or any non-official site) as a source and says so briefly; gives the PM-KISAN instalment dates only from pmkisan.gov.in or PIB, cited; does not predict a date for the next instalment unless an official announcement is found. It may mention that the 24th instalment is scheduled for 30 Oct 2026 (official PM events page, as in Q-423); if asked after that release, naming the 24th as the latest with an official citation is correct.
fail_if: It uses or cites bajajfinserv.in or another unofficial site; gives a date for the 24th instalment other than the officially announced 30 Oct 2026, or without an official source; gives instalment dates without an official citation.
summary: Added from pmkisan.gov.in/PIB: 23rd instalment 20 June 2026 (latest as of 28 Oct 2026), 22nd on 13 March 2026, Rs 6,000/yr in three instalments.
